Malicious encoded PowerShell command executed from Outlook process (T1566.001).

rundll32.exe loaded malicious DLL from Temp, establishing C2 beacon to 198.51.100.23 (T1218.011, T1071.001).
Hosts file modified to redirect security domains (T1565.001).
IDS triggered on Cobalt Strike beacon C2 traffic (ET TROJAN signature).
Failed Kerberos TGT request indicates potential credential dumping attempt.
Successful SMB access to file server 'FS-ACC-001' (lateral movement).
Incident response initiated: credentials revoked, host quarantined, and hardening playbook executed.

    meta:
        description = "Detects common characteristics of Cobalt Strike beacon DLLs dropped in Temp directories"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        maltype = "Trojan"
        date = "2026-04-11"

    strings:
        $beacon_mutex = "Global\\MSCTF.Asm.{" ascii
        $config_indicators = "beacon_type" ascii
        $c2_strings = /https?:\/\/[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}\//
        $temp_path_write = "%%TEMP%%\\[a-zA-Z0-9]{6,}\\.dll" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of ($beacon_mutex, $config_indicators) and $c2_strings and $temp_path_write
}

rule Suspicious_PowerShell_From_Outlook {
    meta:
        description = "Detects PowerShell launched from Outlook with common obfuscation flags"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1566.001"
        tlp = "amber"
        date = "2026-04-11"
    
    strings:
        $powershell_exe = "powershell.exe" nocase
        $hidden_window = "-w hidden" nocase
        $no_profile = "-nop" nocase
        $encoded_command = "-encodedcommand" nocase
        $outlook_parent = "outlook.exe" nocase
    
    condition:
        $outlook_parent and $powershell_exe and $hidden_window and $no_profile and $encoded_command
}
